commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Florian Sotoca (Lens) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
90+6' The referee awards a corner and Andy Diouf (Lens) goes over to take it.
90+5' Florian Sotoca (Lens) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90+4' Lens earn a corner.
90+4' Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
90+2' The foul by Angelo Fulgini (Lens) was seen by Benoit Bastien who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' What was Adrien Thomasson (Lens) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
87' Lens have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
86' Marcin Bulka (Nice) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
84' The game is interrupted now, Marcin Bulka (Nice) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
84' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
82' Francesco Farioli prepares a substitution. Terem Moffi is replaced by Antoine Mendy (Nice).
82' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pablo Rosario.
81' Nice players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
79' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle. Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) commits a foul after dangerous play.
79' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) sends the corner into the box, but Marcin Bulka intercepts it and averts the threat.
78' Pablo Rosario (Nice) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
78' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. David Pereira da Costa will be replaced by Angelo Fulgini (Lens).
76' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adrien Thomasson (Lens) replacing Neil El Aynaoui.
76' 1 - 3 Fantastic team goal! Elye Wahi (Lens) was set free in the area by Wesley Said and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the left side of the net. 1:3.
75' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
75' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
74' 2:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

74' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the left side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Marcin Bulka makes a comfortable save.
72' Lens hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
69' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle and it's Wesley Said (Lens) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
69' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) will deliver the corner kick.
67' 0 - 3 Goal! Terem Moffi (Nice) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Brice Samba into the bottom right corner.
66' Terem Moffi (Nice) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
65' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

65' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. PENALTY to Nice! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
65' Romain Perraud (Nice) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andy Diouf (Lens) comes onto the pitch so that Nampalys Mendy can be given a rest.
63' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ruben Aguilar walks off the pitch to be replaced by Wesley Said (Lens).
62' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

53' 0 - 2 Goal! Mohamed-Ali Cho passes the ball to the feet of Khephren Thuram (Nice), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 0:2.

51' The ball is out of play and Lens manage to earn a corner.
49' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
46' Yellow card. Romain Perraud (Nice) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
46' Half-time substitution. Jonathan Gradit (Lens) is replaced by Abdukodir Khusanov.

45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Elye Wahi (Lens) is flagged for offside.
44' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
43' Nice keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.

41' What a wasted opportunity by Florian Sotoca (Lens)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the right side of the goal, but Marcin Bulka makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
40' Elye Wahi (Lens) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles past the left post.
40' Khephren Thuram (Nice) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
38' Romain Perraud (Nice) takes a short corner kick.
38' Romain Perraud (Nice) takes the free kick which is inaccurate and the defence has no problem with the clearance.
37' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
36' Benoit Bastien has a clear sight and sees a foul from Romain Perraud (Nice).
35' Flag goes up against Terem Moffi (Nice) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
35' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
34' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:5.
32' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marcin Bulka, who smothers the ball.
31' Morgan Sanson is being substituted because of an injury. Francesco Farioli sends Tom Louchet (Nice) on the pitch.
30' Morgan Sanson (Nice) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
29' Lens are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
26' Romain Perraud (Nice) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
26' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
24' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Elye Wahi (Lens) inside the box.
22' Khephren Thuram (Nice) makes a rough challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
19' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
18' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Elye Wahi (Lens) heads on.
17' Terem Moffi (Nice) is adjudged offside.
17' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
17' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) takes the corner with a short pass.
15' Florian Sotoca (Lens) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
13' Terem Moffi (Nice) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post.
13' Morgan Sanson (Nice) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul.

9' Facundo Medina (Lens) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

5' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) commits a rough foul. Benoit Bastien stops the game and makes a call.
4' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
3' Romain Perraud (Nice) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
2' Morgan Sanson (Nice) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
1' Pablo Rosario (Nice) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
